# Bronco Ledger policies

Public privacy notice and terms for a private, single-owner personal finance application maintained by Achref Soua. This repository contains only static policy pages, their styles, and public font/icon assets. Application source, account records, certificates and credentials do not belong here.

Published with free GitHub Pages from the root of `main`:

- https://achref-soua.github.io/bronco-ledger-policies/privacy/
- https://achref-soua.github.io/bronco-ledger-policies/terms/

The policies describe the current local application, not a publicly hosted banking service. Publishing them does not activate bank access or certify provider approval.

## Maintain

Edit `privacy/index.html` or `terms/index.html`, update its effective/review date when the substance changes, and review the matching notice when changing the application's data handling. Use relative asset and navigation paths so the site works under the GitHub Pages repository prefix. Keep the public contact address current.

Preview without installing dependencies:

```sh
python3 -m http.server 8890 --bind 127.0.0.1
```

Visit http://localhost:8890/. The site needs no JavaScript, forms, cookies, analytics, external fonts, package manager, or paid services. It follows the system light/dark preference and supports printing.

GitHub hosts the public documents and logs visitor IP addresses for security; see the privacy notice. The public site never calls bank APIs or receives account data.

The Bricolage Grotesque font is distributed under its included [SIL Open Font License](assets/fonts/OFL-bricolage-grotesque.txt). The favicon is the owner's existing public portfolio mark.
